title: Balance sweep pre-registration
description: Committed BEFORE a sweep runs. test/harness/bench/analyze.mjs refuses to emit a verdict for a familyId with no matching, schema-valid file here; it prints descriptives under an EXPLORATORY - NO VERDICT banner instead. Any metric or cell analysed that is not declared here is tagged EXPLORATORY per-row. See docs/plans/2026-08-14-balance-harness-v2-spec.md section 3.

familyId.description: Matches the familyId stamped into every run record. Also this file's basename.

question.description: The single question this family answers, in one sentence.

primaryMetric.description: Exactly one. Every other metric analysed is secondary or exploratory. Naming two primaries is how a family silently doubles its own multiplicity.

secondaryMetrics.description: Declared, so they are corrected rather than mined. Counted in familySize.

mde.description: Minimum detectable effect, in units of primaryMetric, declared BEFORE the run. The smallest difference worth calling a gameplay change - not the effect you expect to find.

sigmaSource.description: Where the sigma feeding nRequired came from - which corpus, which metric, which value. A sigma taken from an underpowered pilot is how Phase 8A under-sized itself twice.

nRequired.description: Per-arm cell count from stats.js requiredN(sigma, mde) at the declared alpha/power. The runner warns if the sweep is smaller.

arms.description: armId values. Must include the control arm.

familySize.description: Number of hypothesis tests the Benjamini-Hochberg correction spans: normally (arms - 1) * mazes * (1 + secondaryMetrics). Declared here so the correction cannot be quietly narrowed after seeing the results.

decisionRule.description: The full conjunction that constitutes a PASS. State every gate: BH-adjusted q, sign test agreement, split-half rho, hang-imputation survival, cross-policy agreement.

whatWouldRefute.description: The observation that would make this a FAIL. A family whose every possible outcome reads as confirmation is not measuring anything - that is precisely how the 2026-07-25 baseline over-read itself.

positiveControl.description: Optional but strongly preferred: an arm carrying a deliberately injected balance change of known size, used to prove the instrument can recover an effect at the declared mde. Success criterion 3 in the spec. A SINGLE-arm control declares expectedEffect (a number, in primaryMetric units). A LADDER control spanning several doses has no single expected effect and declares expectedDirection instead: the ordering commitment IS the pre-registered prediction. Exactly one of the two is required — loadRegistration enforces that, because this validator has no anyOf.

override.description: Dotted BALANCE path, per scenarios.js resolveDial.

expectedDirection.description: For ladder controls: the committed sign and shape of the response across the ladder, per maze.

regime.description: The measurement regime the family was taken in. Declared here because a corpus is only interpretable against the protocol that produced it, and because a regime chosen AFTER seeing results is the same defect as a metric chosen after seeing results.

protocol.description: Protocol overrides defining the regime, e.g. spendDown/maxWaves.

justification.description: Why this regime, on evidence. Sensitivity to a known defence change, not the survival band.

scopeLimit.description: What this regime structurally CANNOT measure. Declared up front, not discovered afterwards.

amendedAt.description: When the registration was amended. Only legitimate BEFORE any analysis has been run against the family; amendmentNote must say so explicitly.

amendmentNote.description: What changed, why, and — critically — whether any analysis had been performed when the amendment was made. An amendment made after seeing results is post-hoc and the family is exploratory.

registeredAt.description: Must predate the earliest startedAt in the sweep. analyze.mjs warns if it does not - that is a post-registration and the verdict is exploratory.
